case_title.quote: PATHAN HUSSAIN BASHA v. STATE OF A.P.

number_of_accused.quote: The trial court convicted all the three accused
number_of_accused.reason: Three accused were tried; one was later acquitted.

accused_gender.correct_value: Male and female (husband, father-in-law male; mother-in-law female)
accused_gender.reason: Accused include a woman, the mother-in-law, so 'Male' alone is incomplete.

accused_age.reason: No accused age is given in the judgment.

accused_religion.reason: Religion is not stated; only Ramzan and Muslim law are mentioned in passing.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: Socioeconomic status of the accused is not stated.

victim_gender.reason: The victim was a married woman.

victim_age.reason: The victim's age is never mentioned.

accused_victim_relationship.correct_value: Husband and mother-in-law (in-laws) of the deceased
accused_victim_relationship.quote: accused Pathan Hussain Basha, was married to Pathan Haseena Begum
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Husband and in-laws; 'Spouse, Relative' is vague but roughly right.

offence_category.reason: Dowry death under s.304-B is the central offence.

weapon.reason: No weapon was used; death was by hanging with a saree.

evidence_type.correct_value: Witness testimony (family, neighbours), medical/post-mortem evidence, seizure of saree
evidence_type.reason: No eyewitness to the hanging; 'eyewitness' is a stretch, though other types are fine.

aggravating_circumstances.quote: dowry demands were being raised by the accused persons persistently
aggravating_circumstances.reason: Dowry demands, harassment and cruelty are supported.

mitigating_circumstances.quote: the age of the accused and the fact that they have already being in jail for a considerable period
mitigating_circumstances.reason: Matches the court's stated mitigating factors.

trial_court_outcome.correct_value: Convicted under ss.498A and 304-B; 3 years RI plus Rs.1,000 fine under 498A and life imprisonment under 304-B, concurrent
trial_court_outcome.quote: sentenced to undergo imprisonment for LIFE for the offence u/s. 304-B IPC
trial_court_outcome.reason: Life imprisonment is correct, but the 498A sentence and fine are omitted.

high_court_outcome.quote: acquitted accused No. 3, namely, Pathan Khadar Basha. The sentence awarded by the Trial Court was confirmed.

final_outcome.correct_value: Appeals partly allowed; conviction upheld, sentence reduced to ten years RI
final_outcome.reason: Convicted is right but omits the sentence reduction.

offence_finally_established.quote: ingredients of Section 304B read with Section 498A IPC are completely satisfied
offence_finally_established.reason: Dowry death and cruelty are upheld.

imprisonment_type.quote: we award ten years Rigorous Imprisonment
imprisonment_type.reason: A fixed term of ten years was imposed.

imprisonment_years.quote: we award ten years Rigorous Imprisonment

fine_rs.quote: further sentenced to pay a fine of Rs. 1,000/- each
fine_rs.reason: A fine was imposed by the trial court and not set aside; null is wrong.

neutral_facts.correct_value: The accused husband and his mother (not 'his mother-in-law') were charged ...
neutral_facts.quote: accused Pathan Hussain Basha, his father ... and mother Pathan Nazeer Abi
neutral_facts.reason: Calls the accused mother-in-law of the husband ambiguously and omits the third accused; otherwise accurate.

offence_severity.correct_value: Life imprisonment at trial, reduced to ten years RI
offence_severity.quote: we award ten years Rigorous Imprisonment
offence_severity.reason: Roughly right but vaguely worded; omits 498A sentence.

attempt_completion.reason: The death occurred, so the offence was completed.

physical_harm.quote: cause of death was stated to be asphyxia, as a result of hanging

number_of_offences.quote: Accused were charged with offences under Sections 498A and 304B of the IPC.
number_of_offences.reason: Only two offences were charged; 'three' counts is wrong.

financial_property_loss.correct_value: Dowry of Rs. 15,000 paid; Rs. 10,000 balance demanded; items like fan given
financial_property_loss.quote: Out of this amount, a sum of Rs. 15,000/-was paid at that time
financial_property_loss.reason: Dowry payments and demands are described, so 'Not applicable' is not accurate.

motive.quote: harassed the deceased primarily for non-payment of the amount of dowry

key_evidence_accepted.quote: the prosecution by reliable and cogent evidence has established the guilt of the accused

witness_credibility.correct_value: Court relied on LW-1, LW-3, LW-7 testimony as corroborated, but did not explicitly assess credibility
witness_credibility.quote: The statement of this witness i.e. LW-1 is corroborated by LW-3 and LW-7.
witness_credibility.reason: Corroboration is noted, but no detailed credibility assessment was made.

post_offence_conduct.correct_value: Accused were absent when the body was found and did not explain the death
post_offence_conduct.quote: found the accused absent and the bride hanging in the house
post_offence_conduct.reason: The judgment notes absence and failure to explain, so 'Not stated' is incomplete.

custody_duration.correct_value: Arrested 16 Feb 2003; court notes they have been in jail for a considerable period
custody_duration.quote: they have already being in jail for a considerable period
custody_duration.reason: Exact duration not stated, but the arrest date and 'considerable period' are noted.

legal_representation.quote: Param Kumar Mishra (for Kumud Lata Das) for the Appellant D. Mahesh Babu for the Respondent.

investigation_status.quote: Investigating Officer arrested all the three accused persons.

prosecution_argument.quote: deceased was being harassed and ill-treated by her husband, father-in-law and mother-in-law

defence_argument.correct_value: Appellants argued for a lenient view on sentence given prosecution evidence, age and long jail period
defence_argument.quote: some substance in the argument raised on behalf of the appellants
defence_argument.reason: Only the sentence-leniency argument is recorded; the stated defence arguments are invented.

legal_principle_applied.quote: By a deeming fiction in law, the onus shifts on to the accused

precedent_relied_upon.quote: Biswajit Halder alias Babu Halder and Others v. State of W.B. ... Ashok Kumar v. State of Haryana

sentencing_rationale.quote: keeping in view the prosecution evidence, the attendant circumstances, the age of the accused

judicial_mitigating_factors.quote: the age of the accused and the fact that they have already being in jail for a considerable period

judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: No aggravating factors are discussed in sentencing.

other_sentence_order.reason: No other orders were made by this Court.
